changelog: New voice command "copy last sentence" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ বাক্য কপি করো" in Bengali) and the sentence right before the cursor is copied to the clipboard in one step, so you can paste it anywhere without the two-step "select last sentence" + "copy". It is the one-segment version of v14.7's select. The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 51 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
